familiarity.currentGraphTruthSession: known after frozen candidate selection; non-blind workflow evidence only

orderedProcedure.name: implement-zone-3
orderedProcedure.rule: Implement only the five admitted capabilities with Node built-ins.

orderedProcedure.name: synthetic-verification
orderedProcedure.rule: Exercise append-only capture, horizon isolation, open-question persistence, fail-closed behavior, and exact rebuild on synthetic bytes.

orderedProcedure.name: freeze-implementation
orderedProcedure.rule: Hash the exact runtime and tests before either real branch begins.

orderedProcedure.name: baseline-h1
orderedProcedure.rule: Execute fixed queries q1 through q3 once and retain the t1 answer before any H2 query.

orderedProcedure.name: baseline-h2
orderedProcedure.rule: Execute fixed queries q4 through q6 once and retain t2 through t4. Freeze the full baseline output.

orderedProcedure.name: graphtruth-h1
orderedProcedure.rule: Start the sole GraphTruth run, ingest H1, capture its spans and assertions, close H1, build the H1 dossier, and retain t1 before ingesting H2.

orderedProcedure.name: graphtruth-h2
orderedProcedure.rule: Append H2 snapshots, spans, revisions, residual assertions, and the frozen open question; close the corpus; retain t2 through t4.

orderedProcedure.name: rebuild-and-score
orderedProcedure.rule: Rebuild the generated projection exactly, verify hashes, score all eight cells, and retain the report without retry.

orderedProcedure.name: owner-disposition
orderedProcedure.rule: Stop after full repository checks and ask the owner for keep, shrink, or stop.
